input.free_text_description: This system is a task management platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for abstract, service. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to use abstract capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use service capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Admin, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
